answer: Every receipt is time-locked for 30 days and split across three independent auditors, so no single agent can approve its own history. An attacker must fund 30 days of waiting plus three separate review relationships per identity, which puts the cheapest clone near 40 hours of coordination before it scores a point. Honest work buys the same standing in 6 hours of output. An ivory nameplate and a ferrous rack of clones land on the same terrace, and only one of them did the work.
